sources.findings: Lists image edit endpoint support and only the same undated model identifier under snapshots. Published standard rates per million tokens: text input 5 USD, image input 8 USD, image output 30 USD.

POST /v1/images/edits accepts JSON with up to 16 ordered image references, including base64 data URLs. Per image_url limit 20971520 characters; prompt limit 32000. Standard square 1024x1024, n=1, PNG, opaque, high quality and medium complexity are supported. GPT image responses return base64 image data. No mask, markup, streaming or partial images are used. input_fidelity is documented for older models, not as a configurable Sunburst fidelity setting; omitted.

Recommends the 2.6 models for new work; complexity is separate from rendering quality and can affect unwanted changes. Total cost includes text input, image inputs and output. The cost calculator is an estimate; actual token counts vary. No legacy fixed per-image price is substituted.
Standard non-batch Sunburst image input 8 USD/million, output 30 USD/million; text input 5 USD/million. No cached-input discount assumed in this estimate.
API usage is billed independently of a ChatGPT Plus subscription.

Some eligible Pro/Business subscribers can separately link an API organization and claim API credits. This does not increase signed-in Codex limits or prove that this operator has credits. No account or balance request was made.

costEstimate.uncertainty: These are deliberately generous planning assumptions for all four original images and one high-quality 1024-square output, not observed token counts, provider quotes or bounds. Actual charge can fall outside this interval. n=1 and one client request do not cap internal operations or final billing. Account-specific access, credits, tax, balances and quota were not queried. Treat timeout/disconnect and every network attempt as potentially billable.
